We ended a perfect meal with Bananas Foster, served flaming. Wow! Don’t skip dessert!

The prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and service we received. Big fans and we will be back on our next beach visit!

reviewer_name: Tracey Powers
rating: 5
body: Had our first meal at Pelican Grill in Orange Beach, and it certainly won’t be the last! It is located directly underneath Louisiana Lagniappe on a marina. The views are gorgeous, definitely a great atmosphere! The staff was very friendly and our service was wonderful. There was live music outside at their outdoor bar, The Tipsy Pelican.

Now, on to the food! We ordered the Bourbon Filet and Blackened Grouper topped with crab meat and beurre blanc sauce. The Bourbon Filet was one of the best we’ve ever tasted. That bourbon sauce is flavorful and absolutely delicious! The grouper was also delicious. I have never had mixed vegetables julienned in strips before, and I gotta say, it’s my new favorite way to eat veggies. These were so good! Everything was flavorful. We ended a perfect meal with Bananas Foster, served flaming. Wow! Don’t skip dessert!

The prices were very reasonable for the quality of food and service we received. Big fans and we will be back on our next beach visit!
